catalog-menu.description: Builds the menu from the Commerce category tree. Insert it into the nav document: one click adds the menu list and the block together. Keep the line "Commerce: All" (or "Commerce: " and a category name) in the list; a two-cell row in the block links a category's url path to a page.

catalog-menu.structureOnly: it reads the category tree from a live store, writes it into the site menu, then removes itself from the page, so there is nothing to see on its own.
